latestVersion.changelog:
ai-video-editor-canva 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Quickly create branded promo videos from images or clips with simple text commands, no complex editing.
- Drag-and-drop upload (supports MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG up to 500MB) and fast 1080p cloud rendering.
- Seamless export of finished videos as MP4 files, ready to download and share.
- Automatic new-user onboarding with easy token generation; no prior setup required.
- Built-in support for text overlays, background music, timeline preview, and credit management.
- Guided error handling and clear user feedback throughout the video editing workflow.
